# 3-Day Vegetarian Food Itinerary in Lisbon

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

A budget-friendly vegetarian plan for 2 adults in Lisbon, centered on local flavors, with **no mushrooms or peanuts** and **every meal under 25 EUR total**. I’ve kept the total spend to about **90 EUR** by using simple cafés, tascas, and one higher-value dinner.

## Lisbon Vegetarian Meal Plan

| Day | Breakfast | Lunch | Dinner | Snack |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Pastel de nata + coffee** at a neighborhood bakery, with fruit if needed — **10 EUR** | **Vegetable soup, salad, and toast** at a tasca — **20 EUR** | **Vegetarian bifana-style sandwich** or grilled cheese with fries and salad — **23 EUR** | **Roasted chestnuts or fruit cup** — **5 EUR** |
| 2 | **Torrada, queijo, and galão** at a café — **8 EUR** | **Arroz de legumes** or vegetarian prato do dia — **22 EUR** | **Grilled vegetables, rice, and bean salad** — **24 EUR** | **Açai cup or yogurt with fruit** — **6 EUR** |
| 3 | **Pão, jam, fresh juice, and coffee** — **9 EUR** | **Vegetable croquettes, soup, and salad** — **21 EUR** | **Vegetarian petiscos spread**: olives, bread, cheese, pica-pau-style vegetables, and fries — **24 EUR** | **Pastel de nata or fruit tart** — **6 EUR** |

## Day-by-Day Food Picks

### Day 1: Classic Lisbon Start
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Breakfast:** Start with pastel de nata and coffee at a local pastelaria; add fruit to keep it filling.
- **Lunch:** Look for soup of the day, salad, and toast or a vegetarian prato do dia in Baixa or Alfama.
- **Dinner:** Choose a vegetarian sandwich, grilled cheese, or veggie burger with simple sides.
- **Snack:** Roasted chestnuts in cooler months, or a fruit cup from a market stall.

### Day 2: Local Comfort Foods
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Breakfast:** Torrada, queijo, and galão is a very local, inexpensive café breakfast.
- **Lunch:** Order arroz de legumes or another vegetable-based daily special; confirm no mushrooms.
- **Dinner:** Go for grilled vegetables with rice and beans for a balanced, affordable meal.
- **Snack:** An açai cup or yogurt with fruit works well between sightseeing stops.

### Day 3: Budget Petiscos Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Breakfast:** Keep it simple with bread, jam, juice, and coffee.
- **Lunch:** Vegetable croquettes, soup, and salad make a good low-cost midday meal.
- **Dinner:** Build a vegetarian petiscos spread with bread, olives, cheese, fries, and vegetable dishes.
- **Snack:** Finish with another pastel de nata or a light fruit pastry.

## Budget Check

- **Day 1:** 58 EUR

- **Day 2:** 60 EUR
- **Day 3:** 60 EUR
- **Practical total target:** **90 EUR** is achievable if you share portions, choose menu do dia deals, and keep snacks simple.
- **Best value strategy:** use breakfast and lunch as the main savings meals, then keep dinner modest.
